comment: Tasks T2.3 and T2.4: the pairwise domain-segmentation network and the clustering decoder. The decoder's thresholds are plain starting points; the proposal tunes them on validation data in T3.5.
comment_network: input_dim is taken from the encoder, so it is not set here. Dilations double to give a receptive field wider than a typical domain; pair_rank keeps the pairwise head low-rank so its memory does not grow with the square of chain length.
comment_decoder: The four constraints the proposal names: minimum domain length, acceptable linker gaps, residue coverage and interval consistency.
